title: Willow Creek Farm
note: A pure projection of farm.db. Paddocks, silos, the herd, and deliveries — every object is a SQL query over the farm's own tables. Click anything to see it.

buildings.name: Long Paddock
buildings.label: Long Paddock · barley
buildings.query:
SELECT name, hectares, crop, status, expected_yield_t
FROM paddocks WHERE name = 'Long Paddock';

buildings.name: North 40
buildings.label: North 40 · wheat
buildings.query:
SELECT name, hectares, crop, status, expected_yield_t
FROM paddocks WHERE name = 'North 40';

buildings.name: River Bend

buildings.name: Home Block

buildings.name: Supplier Gate
buildings.label: Supplier Gate
buildings.query:
SELECT counterparty, tonnes, due_on FROM deliveries
WHERE kind = 'feed_in' AND dispatched_on IS NULL;

buildings.name: Milking Parlour
buildings.label: Milking Parlour

buildings.name: Drying Shed
buildings.label: Drying Shed
buildings.query:
SELECT count(*), round(avg(tonnes),1) FROM harvest_loads
WHERE loaded_at > date('now','-14 days');

buildings.name: Silo A — wheat
buildings.label: Silo A · wheat
buildings.query:
SELECT name, current_t, capacity_t, moisture_pct
FROM silos WHERE name = 'Silo A';

buildings.name: Silo B — barley
buildings.label: Silo B · barley
buildings.query:
SELECT name, current_t, capacity_t, moisture_pct
FROM silos WHERE name = 'Silo B';

buildings.name: Silo C — canola
buildings.label: Silo C · canola
buildings.query:
SELECT name, current_t, capacity_t, moisture_pct
FROM silos WHERE name = 'Silo C';

buildings.name: Feed Silo
buildings.label: Feed Silo
buildings.query: SELECT current_t, capacity_t FROM silos WHERE name = 'Feed Silo';

buildings.name: Dispatch Shed
buildings.label: Dispatch
buildings.query:
SELECT kind, counterparty, tonnes, due_on FROM deliveries
WHERE dispatched_on IS NULL ORDER BY due_on;
